pages.summary: Tightened pickup notice instructions and removed a broken hook-notes link while retaining the full and partial pickup contract.
Removed issue tracking and engine-maintenance details while preserving owned stack semantics and write-boundary guarantees.
Removed codec roadmap and issue references, and clarified registration refusal and fail-closed reload behavior.
Corrected native callback signatures to include tags in their actual final parameter position and described borrowed JSON and authoritative tag access.
Removed unrelated contract tracking while retaining tag lookup, reload identity and unavailable-mapping rules.

Rewrote category registration with all required fields, recipe displays and placement rules. Corrected atomic generation refusal, multiple categories per recipe type and cached lookup behavior, and removed obsolete UI limitations and design links.
